baseline_and_metrics.value: Foresight: mean absolute margin of error 19% (214 forecasts, 26 countries; median 11%); vs. humanitarian response plans on 123 plans: plans 23% (median 17%), Foresight 19% (median 12%). Foresight underestimates in 60% of forecasts. AHEAD: MAPE 15% (315 hindcasts, Burkina Faso); two baselines (constant level; 24-month trend) both 21%. AHEAD underestimates in 52%. Classification at 1,200-person threshold: 69% correct actions, 17% false negatives, 14% false positives; at 10,000 actions taken only 12% of the time. Surge error: 21% when increase >4,759 over three months; 34% when relative increase >35.4%; correlation 0.74 (sample sizes and surge figures from summary pass, not separately verbatim-verified).
